It is absolutely critical to our national security that we stay ahead of our near-peer adversaries, particularly China, so that we maintain our superior advantage.

The United States is home to the world’s leading companies and innovators who are driving the development of cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, and next-generation wireless technologies. These innovations are critical not just to our economy, but to the future of global connectivity.

while advancement of AI has so much potential to improve efficiencies across many industries, it can also be used maliciously and cause serious damage. While we have seen a few instances of placing measured safeguards on certain uses of AI, we must balance any regulation with enabling innovation.

Our adversaries will stop at nothing to undermine our leadership in technological advancement and utilize AI to threaten our way of life. We must continue to innovate and develop to prevent that from happening. Competition in AI is a global issue, and it is imperative that the United States maintains its leadership.

We use AI everyday whether we realize it or not. As it grows, we have to ensure the infrastructure is ready to support our use and stay a global leader in innovation.
